Container.Name: nomad_admin
Container.Overview: Project N.O.M.A.D. is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Its web "Command Center" installs and manages other containers for you: offline Wikipedia and references (Kiwix), Khan Academy courses (Kolibri), offline maps, AI chat with document search (Ollama + Qdrant), CyberChef, FlatNotes and more.[br][br] [b]Before installing:[/b][br] 1. Create the Docker network from the Unraid terminal: [code]docker network create project-nomad_default[/code] (and enable "Preserve user defined networks" in Settings > Docker so it survives reboots).[br] 2. Install the [b]nomad-mysql[/b] and [b]nomad-redis[/b] templates from this repo first, on the same network.[br] 3. Use the same password here (DB_PASSWORD) as MYSQL_PASSWORD in nomad-mysql.[br][br] [b]Storage:[/b] the Storage path must be identical in the path mapping, NOMAD_STORAGE_PATH, and (if used) the nomad_disk_collector template. Installed apps keep their data under it too, and ZIM files and AI models can get very large.[br][br] There is no built-in login. Keep it on your LAN and do not expose it to the internet.
Container.Requires: The project-nomad_default Docker network, plus the nomad-mysql and nomad-redis containers from this repo running on it.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Command Center web UI.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: All NOMAD data (ZIM libraries, AI models, maps, notes, logs). Installed apps are pointed here too. Must match NOMAD_STORAGE_PATH exactly (case-sensitive).

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets NOMAD create and manage the containers for the apps you install from its UI.

Config.Name: Update shared
Config.Description: Scratch folder the upstream self-updater uses. Not used on Unraid (update through the Docker tab), but kept so the app finds the folder.

Config.Name: URL
Config.Description: The address you open the UI at, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080

Config.Name: APP_KEY
Config.Description: Random secret, at least 16 characters, or the container will not start. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Must match MYSQL_PASSWORD in the nomad-mysql container.

Config.Name: NOMAD_STORAGE_PATH
Config.Description: Host path of the Storage mapping above. Must match it exactly.

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: MySQL container name on the project-nomad_default network. Use hyphens, not underscores: the app rejects hostnames with underscores.

Config.Name: DB_PORT
Config.Description: MySQL port inside the network.

Config.Name: DB_DATABASE
Config.Description: Database name. Must match MYSQL_DATABASE in nomad-mysql.

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Same as DB_DATABASE (upstream sets both).

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: Must match MYSQL_USER in nomad-mysql.

Config.Name: REDIS_HOST
Config.Description: Redis container name on the project-nomad_default network (hyphens, not underscores).

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Leave as production: in other modes installed apps are not attached to the NOMAD network.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Do not change; change the WebUI Port mapping instead.

Config.Name: HOST
Config.Description: Listen address inside the container. Do not change.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: trace, debug, info, warn, error

Config.Name: DISABLE_COMPRESSION
Config.Description: Set to true if gzip causes problems behind your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Overrides the URL used to check internet connectivity (takes precedence over the UI setting).
